name: digiKam
engine: Images: Qt/KDE image loaders, LibRaw, libheif; video: Qt Multimedia QMediaPlayer with bundled FFmpeg (QtAVPlayer in Qt5 builds)
summary: digiKam is a full open-source photo management suite from KDE for large collections. It indexes folders into a database and offers tags, face recognition, geolocation, similarity search, a capable image editor, batch processing and many export targets.
where_it_wins: Database with tags, labels, face recognition, similarity and duplicate search, map and timeline search
Natural language and advanced search across all collections
Full image editor and Batch Queue Manager with versioning
RAW processing via LibRaw, 16-bit and colour management
Video playback speed control and frame stepping
Many export targets (Dropbox, OneDrive, Flickr, Piwigo, HTML galleries) and DLNA
Free, open source, runs on Linux and Windows too
where_schnellbild_wins: No collections to set up and no database scan: point at any folder and look
Quick on network shares and huge folders without indexing
Native macOS app instead of a Qt/KDE port
Arrow-key video skimming, subtitles and audio track choice
Archives and comics (ZIP, RAR, 7z, CBZ, CBR) open like folders
Dual pane with F5/F6, folder bookmarks, boss key
App Sandbox, never online, build attestation
search_terms: simple photo viewer instead of digikam

no_account_no_tracking.note: No account or ads; AI models downloaded on demand and run locally

dark_light_setting.note: Settings > Themes with dark and light colour themes, independent of the system

folder_browsing.note: Albums are real folders, but each root folder must be added as a collection and scanned into a database first

thumbnail_grid.note: Icon view of items; folders shown in the Albums tree (album thumbnails), not as preview tiles in the grid

list_view.note: Table view with sortable, configurable columns

recursive_search.note: Database-wide searches (filename, tags, dates, faces, advanced/natural language search) across all collections

regex_search.note: Search relations are Equal, Like, LessThan, Interval, OneOf, InTree, Near etc.; no regular expressions

network_shares_fast.note: Network-share collections supported, but scanning and change monitoring on network file systems can be slow

multiple_windows.note: One main window plus separate Light Table, Image Editor and Survey windows

bookmarks.note: Albums view docs mention no bookmarks/favourites; not conclusive

img_modern_formats.note: HEIC/HEIF, AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP in the default file filter

img_psd_exr.note: PSD/PSB and EXR in the default file filter

img_svg_pdf.note: Neither SVG nor PDF is in the default item filter

img_animated.note: GIF and WebP are in the still-image filter; MNG is in the video filter (played as video); animated GIF/WebP playback not found

zoom_rotate.note: Zoom/pan in preview and magnifier; rotation is lossless file rotation or EXIF tag change, not view-only

slideshow.note: Basic slideshow, Presentation tool, OpenGL viewer

slideshow_recursive.note: 'Play with Sub-Albums' (Shift+F9); videos play inside the slideshow

auto_enhance_view.note: Features page lists auto-correction tools as Image Editor tools; view-only use not documented either way

file_info_exif.note: Right sidebar with EXIF/IPTC/XMP; video metadata incl. length, fps, size and encoding

video_native.note: Plays MP4/MOV in preview and slideshow

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: FFmpeg-based; MKV, WebM, AVI, WMV, MTS, VOB in the default filter (FLV not listed)

photos_videos_one_grid.note: Albums show photos and videos together

video_skim_arrows.note: Player has frame forward/backward buttons; arrow keys switch items

subtitles_embedded.note: Player code has no subtitle handling

audio_track_choice.note: Only audio output device selection (9.1.0), no track choice in player code

music_mode.note: Audio files (MP3, FLAC, OGG …) in the default filter with an audio player widget

video_filters_enhance.note: Player offers rotate, capture frame, rate; no picture adjustments

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: Not documented on the download page

archives_as_folders.note: No archive formats in file filters

manga_two_page.note: Light Table compares images side by side, no reading mode

rename_trash.note: Rename, own recoverable trash per collection, new album folders

move_copy.note: Drag onto an album, choose Move Here or Copy Here

dual_pane.note: Not documented; Light Table compares images side by side, not a file-manager dual pane

undo_file_actions.note: Delete moves items to the digiKam Trash (recoverable); undo for renames/moves not documented

image_editing.note: Full image editor with many tools and versioning

batch_convert.note: Batch Queue Manager, batch rename, DNG converter

library_catalog.note: SQLite/MariaDB database with tags, labels, faces, similarity

cloud_sync.note: Export to Dropbox, OneDrive, Flickr, Box, Piwigo and more; DLNA sharing

keyboard_first.note: Extensive shortcuts, but many tasks are sidebar/mouse based

custom_shortcuts.note: KDE shortcut editor with schemes, import/export

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Print button in the shortcut dialog

boss_key.note: Shortcut settings page does not list all actions

app_sandbox.note: Distributed as PKG outside the Mac App Store; entitlements not checkable without installing

no_network.note: Optional web services, map tiles/reverse geocoding, model downloads, update checks, proxy settings

notarized_attested.note: Public source; all downloads GnuPG-signed; macOS notarization and reproducible builds not documented

mac_app_store.note: Not in the Mac App Store
